typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @Count INT SET @Count = ?  SELECT CAST(REPLACE(STR(@Count,10),\' \',\'0\') AS CHAR(10)) + SPACE(158) +CHAR(13)+CHAR(10) AS Header',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> HeaderRow
HeaderRow sink(input(
		Header as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Header)) ~> WriteHeaderRow
